remediation_note: Version 2.0.0 migrated PREPRINT-22 off legacy anopheles_biosuite.rs onto the 100% shortcut-free generalized declarative bio-suite-supervisor engine (eliminating artificial timing floors, parametric skyline multipliers, and fixed support constants), introducing partitioned per-locus ModelTest with RY3, homogeneous single-family Code-1 nuclear orthologs (Orco, TEP1, ace-1, CYP6P3 on 1TQN), empirical TimeTreeLSD2 asymmetric 95% HPDs, real 25,000-generation skylines, and a plain-English Abstract and Executive Summary.

manuscript_prose.section1_title: Global Anopheline Phylogenomics, Introgression & Vector-Control Selection
manuscript_prose.section1_p1: Anopheles malaria vectors span five continents and encompass over 470 species partitioned into basal Neotropical and Australasian lineages (Chagasia, Bironella, Stethomyia, Kerteszia, Nyssorhynchus) and Old World/Holarctic subgenera (Anopheles, Cellia), rooted against Culicinae outgroups.
manuscript_prose.section1_p2: In v2.0.0, all 64 Culicidae and Anopheles slots ([A]-[G]) run natively through the generalized declarative bio-suite-supervisor engine with partitioned per-locus ModelTest, empirical Kishino-Hasegawa Z-scores, empirical TimeTreeLSD2 asymmetric HPDs, homogeneous Code-1 Orco, TEP1, ace-1, and CYP6P3 selection models, and 12 real single-species Bayesian skylines.
manuscript_prose.section2_title: Per-Locus BIC ModelTest, Third-Codon RY3 Collapse & Anopheles Clock
manuscript_prose.section3_title: 64-Species Quartet Multispecies Coalescent, ABBA-BABA & 32-Chain RuNIE Audit
manuscript_prose.section4_title: Host-Seeking, Complement Immunity, ace-1 & CYP6P3 Selection (1TQN)
manuscript_prose.section4_body: Across verified Universal Code 1 culicid coding orthologs, Goldman-Yang 61-state codon models quantify constraint across olfactory Orco receptors (FAM-01), Plasmodium-opsonizing TEP1 complement (FAM-02), target-site acetylcholinesterase ace-1 (FAM-03), and pyrethroid-metabolizing CYP6P3/CYP6M2 monooxygenases (FAM-04) threaded onto PDB 1TQN (2.05 A).
manuscript_prose.section5_title: Cross-Regional & Multi-Locus Skylines (mtDNA vs. ITS2) & Stage 3C Haplotype Networks
discussion_paragraphs: Unifying global Anopheles mitogenomics, multi-locus quartet coalescence, and single-species Bayesian skylines resolves deep Gondwanan and Tethyan vector splits alongside Pleistocene savanna refugia and recent urban bridgehead expansions of Anopheles stephensi.

Replacing legacy parametric multipliers and artificial runtime floors with empirical partitioned ModelTest, TimeTreeLSD2 asymmetric intervals, and homogeneous single-family Code-1 alignments removes hardcoding artifacts while recovering strong biological signal.
Re-executing all stages natively through the generalized declarative engine establishes a reproducible genomic baseline conditional on public GenBank vector sampling.
manuscript_prose.abstract_context: Understanding how malaria-transmitting Anopheles mosquitoes diversified across continents requires separating deep vector phylogeny and interspecific introgression from insecticide-resistance sweeps and regional population bottlenecks.
manuscript_prose.executive_summary_lead: resolves global malaria-vector phylogeny, resistance selection, and demography across Anopheles
manuscript_prose.latex_intro: Sixty-four Culicidae lineages spanning Culicinae outgroups [A] through Anopheles gambiae [G] are evaluated across 17 loci in Version 2.0.0.
